name: export-skills
description: Deduce which locally-installed Claude Code skills can run in Claude Desktop / claude.ai and package the qualifiers into upload-ready zips. Inventories plugin and personal skills (the installed version of each plugin, symlinks resolved, no marketplace dupes), classifies each against Desktop's code-execution sandbox and MCP list, and curates one zip per skill with SKILL.md at the skill folder's root. A skill that breaks a claude.ai upload rule gets no zip and is reported with the reason. Lenient by default (counts the sandbox as available, the way the built-in pdf/docx skills work); pass --strict to leave out skills that run code in the sandbox. Auto-engages when you want to move skills to Claude Desktop, or run it as /export-skills [--strict].
